narrative.overview:
Nesta reads like a family journey recorded in a calm, bilingual ledger—not a fertility startup landing page. Public surfaces use an editorial layout: warm paper backgrounds, deep garden ink type, gold-brown accents, and plainly labelled sections that feel documentary rather than promotional. The signed-in workspace keeps the same botanical palette but shifts to clearer panels, tables, and shadcn/Base UI controls so coordinators and clients can scan status quickly.

Depth is tonal-first: sections change background and hairline borders before shadows appear. Shadows stay soft and sparse—hero care notes, option-card hover, download CTAs—not glassmorphism or heavy elevation stacks.
keyCharacteristics: Two faces, one palette: .home-editorial (Persuade/Read) vs .workspace / product tokens (Operate).
Display type in Fraunces; UI and long copy in Source Sans 3 with Microsoft YaHei in the CJK stack.
Primary actions use filled deep green; secondary actions use underline links or quiet bordered buttons.
No section eyebrows: the h2 carries the meaning; labels are sentence case, untracked—not generic pill badges.
Motion respects prefers-reduced-motion; scroll reveals are optional enhancement.

rules.name: The Two-Green Rule
rules.body: Public editorial ink (#203e32) and product primary (#284e3c) are close cousins—never introduce a third unrelated accent green on the same screen. Gold is for labels and indices, not full-width fills.

rules.name: The Tonal Band Rule
rules.body: Prefer a new section background or top border to separate content; do not stack more than one decorative shadow on a static block.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: No eyebrows above headings; labels are sentence case, untracked, 12px+ and 4.5:1 contrast—never default shadcn Badge styling on public editorial pages.

rules.name: The Bilingual Pair Rule
rules.body: Chinese and English strings share the same hierarchy; do not shrink English to secondary gray unless it is genuinely metadata.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Editorial package and partner cards use borders only until interaction (hover) or semantic emphasis (featured inset bar).

dos: Do use .home-editorial tokens (--home-ink, --home-paper, --home-gold) on public marketing and guide pages that import home.css.
Do use app/product.css semantic tokens for portal, auth, admin, and shadcn components.
Do keep CTAs at least 44px tall on touch targets.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling reveal/hover translate patterns already scoped in CSS.
donts: Don't import generic gray shadcn defaults on the editorial homepage—they override the warm paper world.
Don't use saturated medical blue, gradient hero clichés, or stock happy doctor tropes on public surfaces.
Don't round editorial primary buttons to pill shapes—the 4px corner is part of the ledger identity.
Don't add heavy box-shadow stacks to static content blocks; use tonal bands instead.
